name: gitranks-contribute
description: Work on open-source issues picked for you; you approve each pull request on gitranks.com.

settings.name: GitRanks token
settings.description: Optional: leave it empty and sign in to gitranks.com in your browser with /mcp auth gitranks. Only for clients without sign-in: a token from gitranks.com → Contribute → Settings → Your own agent (MCP), starting with gr_.
